# Hossam Honda Maintenance Center

> Specialized in professional Honda car maintenance, original spare parts, ADAS radar calibration, OBD diagnostics, and AC gas refilling in Amman, Jordan.

## Core Information
- **Name**: Hossam Honda Maintenance Center / مركز حسام لصيانة هوندا
- **Address**: Al-Shahid Road, Amman, Jordan (شارع الشهيد، عمان، الأردن)
- **Phone & WhatsApp**: +962 7 9799 6020 / +962 7 9532 8713
- **Working Hours**: Sunday - Thursday: 09:00 AM - 06:00 PM (Friday Closed)

## Main Page Directory (English)
- [Home](https://housam-honda.com/en): Overview of our Honda auto care center, specialized services, and client testimonials.
- [Services Catalog](https://housam-honda.com/en/services): Description of our top 6 specialized automotive services.
- [About Us](https://housam-honda.com/en/about): Our 30+ year history, mission, expertise, and mechanic certifications.
- [Contact Us](https://housam-honda.com/en/contact): Business hours, direct phone/WhatsApp numbers, and map iframe location.
- [Servicing Plans & Pricing](https://housam-honda.com/en/pricing): Maintenance package quotes (Minor Service, Major Service, Calibration).
- [FAQs](https://housam-honda.com/en/faqs): Common questions regarding parts, scheduling, and service warranties.
- [Blog & Articles](https://housam-honda.com/en/blog): Technical guides on Honda Sensing calibration, ECU flashing, and cooling system care.

## Automotive Services (English Detail Pages)
- [AC Gas Refill & Service](https://housam-honda.com/en/services/AC-Gas-Service): Certified AC refrigerant recharging (R134a/R1234yf), vacuum test, and leak diagnostics.
- [Car Computer Diagnostic](https://housam-honda.com/en/services/Car-Computer-Diagnostic): OBD engine scans, fault code analysis, and electronics troubleshooting.
- [Computer Software Update](https://housam-honda.com/en/services/Computer-Software-Update): Official Honda factory ECU/TCU updates and programming.
- [Maintenance & Repair](https://housam-honda.com/en/services/Maintenance): Routine maintenance, engine repair, transmission services, and electrics.
- [Radar & ADAS Calibration](https://housam-honda.com/en/services/Radar-Calibration): Advanced calibration of Honda Sensing radars and windshield cameras.
- [Genuine Spare Parts](https://housam-honda.com/en/services/Spare-Parts): Original Honda parts, Bosch components, and high-quality catalog alternatives.

## Automotive Services (Arabic Detail Pages)
- [تعبئة غاز وصيانة المكيف](https://housam-honda.com/ar/services/AC-Gas-Service): شحن غاز الفريون الأصلي وفحص تسريب دورة التكييف لسيارات هوندا.
- [فحص كمبيوتر السيارة](https://housam-honda.com/ar/services/Car-Computer-Diagnostic): قراءة أكواد الأعطال وتشخيص الأنظمة الإلكترونية والحساسات.
- [تحديث برمجيات السيارة](https://housam-honda.com/ar/services/Computer-Software-Update): تحديث برمجيات كمبيوتر هوندا والـ ECU الرسمي وإعادة التهيأة.
- [الصيانة العامة](https://housam-honda.com/ar/services/Maintenance): صيانة ميكانيكية وكهربائية وفحص نظام الفرامل والزيوت.
- [معايرة الرادار](https://housam-honda.com/ar/services/Radar-Calibration): معايرة رادار وكاميرات أمان هوندا Sensing بدقة متناهية.
- [قطع الغيار](https://housam-honda.com/ar/services/Spare-Parts): توفير قطع غيار هوندا الأصلية وبدائل بوش عالية الجودة.
